iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA board demanded full Iranian accounting of 60 percent enriched uranium stocks and restored inspector access; Tehran denounced the resolution as political. No verified higher-level enrichment jump or device event.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: US and Iran exchanged fresh strikes after an Apache incident near Oman; reporting still shows restricted Hormuz traffic, Iranian closure claims, drone threats to shipping, and narrow waterway-settlement talk.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Reuters and Al Jazeera reporting still show Israeli operations continuing in Lebanon, Hezbollah rejection of the Washington stand-down plan, and Israeli refusal to withdraw from southern positions.

turkey.name: TURKEY-NATO
turkey.notes: Turkey remains exposed through NATO air-defense burden and Iran-war spillover; this scan found no fresh Turkish kinetic step or official atomic warning in the current window.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: Pakistan warned India after an Indian army-chief annihilation threat; rhetorical risk rose, but no corroborated current border movement surge surfaced in this scan.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains anchored in May strategic-force exercises and Ryabkov direct-clash warnings; this scan found no fresh NATO attack or new official atomic warning.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: Search results mainly resurfaced late-2025 and early-2026 blockade-drill material; no fresh direct clash, live blockade, or invasion-threshold event appeared in this window.

north_korea.name: DPRK
north_korea.notes: Search results surfaced April projectile events and Russia-alignment material, but no fresh flight event or atomic device event in the current window.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Guardian/Al Jazeera/NucNet reporting on the June 7 Chornobyl spent-fuel-site drone damage keeps nuclear-safety escalation acute while the wider war shows no slowdown.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Al Jazeera reports Pakistani air raids killed at least 13 Afghans, including 11 children, after a TTP-linked attack; the border war has re-escalated after a short calm.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: AP/NWA reports RSF drone strikes overnight in El-Obeid killed at least 15 and hit a funeral, gas station, food truck, civilian neighborhoods, and infrastructure.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza remains in active violence with mediators still trying to secure a pause; latest search results are older than the core Iran/Lebanon items but do not show durable de-escalation.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: Abyei remains elevated from UN concern and reduced mission posture, but no acute fresh clash threshold was met in this scan.

latest_news.headline: US and Iran exchange fresh southern-Iran/Hormuz strikes
latest_news.text: NYT/Hindu/ISW-linked reporting says US forces struck southern Iran after an Apache incident near Oman while Iranian drones threatened Hormuz traffic and narrow waterway-settlement talk remained unresolved.
sources: Institute for the Study of War

latest_news.headline: IAEA demands Iran uranium accounting and access
latest_news.text: AP/IAEA reporting says the watchdog board demanded urgent Iranian cooperation, full accounting of near weapons-grade material, and access to affected sites.

latest_news.headline: Russian drone damages Chornobyl spent-fuel facility
latest_news.text: Guardian/Al Jazeera/NucNet report a Shahed strike damaged a building at the Chornobyl spent-fuel storage site, sustaining nuclear-safety escalation pressure.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan air raids kill Afghan civilians
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera reports Pakistani air raids killed at least 13 people in Afghanistan, including 11 children, after a TTP-linked attack in Pakistan.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon stand-down plan frays
latest_news.text: Reuters and Al Jazeera report Israel continued operations in Lebanon while Hezbollah rejected the Washington stand-down plan and Israel refused a southern withdrawal.

latest_news.headline: India-Pakistan annihilation rhetoric raises risk
latest_news.text: The Media Line reports Pakistan accused India’s army chief of warmongering after an annihilation threat; rhetorical risk rose without a corroborated fresh border movement surge.

latest_news.headline: Russia-NATO direct-clash warnings persist
latest_news.text: Reuters and DGAP point to May Russian strategic-force exercises and Ryabkov warnings about rising direct-clash risk; no fresh direct NATO incident surfaced today.

latest_news.headline: Turkey remains spillover-exposed, no new trigger
latest_news.text: Search results resurfaced earlier Iranian missile interceptions over Turkish airspace; no fresh Turkish kinetic action or official atomic warning was confirmed.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan blockade-drill results stale; no fresh clash
